fields.title: Hot Item 1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle with Auto Shut-Off and Boil-Dry Protection for Home Office

fields.bullets[1]: 304 stainless steel interior, concealed heating element

fields.title: 4.5L Digital Air Fryer with 8 Presets and 60-Min Timer
fields.bullets[0]: 8 one-touch presets for fries, wings and veggies
fields.description: PTFE-free nonstick surface for healthier cooking.

fields.title: Handheld Garment Steamer 1200W, Free Shipping
fields.bullets[0]: Vertical and horizontal steaming with fabric brush

fields.title: Portable Blender Cup 350ml USB-C Rechargeable!
fields.bullets[0]: Eco-friendly Tritan cup, rinses clean in seconds
fields.bullets[1]: Safety lock: motor stops when the cup is detached

cases.why_zh: 标题有感叹号；五点里的 Eco-friendly 同时触发五点禁用词和 FTC 笼统环保宣称。

fields.title: Electric Kettle 1.7L, 304 Stainless Steel, Auto Shut-Off
fields.description: Proudly crafted in America by our design team. Now only $29.99 while in stock.

cases.why_zh: 描述写 crafted in America（美国原产宣称），还写了价格和库存；29.99 远高于出厂价，不算低价。
